name: TeamStarWolf - North Korea-attributed threat actors
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 251 Enterprise techniques bound in case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_NORTH_KOREA.md: the 240 techniques in the direct ATT&CK v20.0 records of the eight North Korea-attributed groups (G0032, G0067, G0082, G0094, G0138, G1036, G1049, G1052), scored 100, plus 11 techniques stated only in US and allied advisories (AA23-040A, AA24-207A), scored 60. Each comment names the groups or advisory and the study's source numbers. Scores indicate evidence basis, not frequency or severity.
